question.problem:
Evaluate the double integral ${∬}_{D}xy\,\text{d}A,$ where 
$D=\{(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le 1,\,0\le y\le 1\}.$
question.worked_solution:
First, we express our double integral as a repeated integral:  

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{D}xy\,\text{d}A & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{0}^{1}xy\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $x$, treating $y$ as a constant:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{0}^{1}xy\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y & ={\int }_{0}^{1}y[{\int }_{0}^{1}x\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}y{[\frac{{x}^{2}}{2}]}_{0}^{1}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}y(\frac{{1}^{2}}{2}-\frac{{0}^{2}}{2})\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}\frac{y}{2}\,\text{d}y\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $y:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}\frac{y}{2}\,\text{d}y & ={[\frac{{y}^{2}}{4}]}_{0}^{1} \\  & =\frac{{1}^{2}}{4}-\frac{{0}^{2}}{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{4}\end{aligned}
$$
